text: This landing adds two MOZ_ASSERT calls and the new UID utility test's ASSERT_EQ without an explicit expected-result message. The same calls remain in the inspected fixed source. Under the current user-directed assertion rule, those changed sites need messages stating that the UID should be nonzero, the sorted UID should not precede the previous UID, and the UID-set string should match the expected result. The nearby comment and test name do not supply those message arguments. This is a scoped manual review finding; no runtime failure or policy learned from historical acceptance is claimed.
title: The added UID formatter assertions omit explicit expected-result messages
